New features: Documents: "PDF pages | Text as read" - each paragraph whole, the words taken out struck on the old side and the words put in marked on the new; N / P, click and scroll-together work in both
Documents: tables in a specification are read row by row and cell by cell - a changed cell shows as that cell, not as a paragraph removed and another added
Documents and BOQ: pictures inside the pages are compared - a changed photo, colour swatch or table pasted as a picture is listed and boxed on both sides
Pictures: a logo on every page is left out (a note says so); the words inside a picture are not read - check it by eye; a figure drawn with lines on a text page is compared by its words
All three tabs: chips All / Figures / To review steer N / P; "Same change in N other places" with "Tick all" (Shift + R); Figures and Group columns in Details and the Excel registers
Documents: the strip shows where the change is (the headings above it), the figures old → new, and the whole change
Drawings: a legend says what each colour on the sheet means
Help › Report a problem: write what went wrong and press Send - made anonymous first: no names, folders, paths or files leave the PC
The user count: once a day a random number, the version and Windows - nothing else. It asks first; Settings › Privacy turns it off
Updates come from the Rev Radar page on GitHub, signed: a package that is not exactly what was published is refused
Fixes: Documents: a sign, a comparator or a percent that changed (+5 → -5, ≥ → >, 50% → 50) is a change, boxed on the page - it was shown as "punctuation only"; BOQ: the changed sign is boxed too
Documents: a date that changed and nothing else is listed (light, "Date / revision only") - it was left out
Documents: a number alone on its line, a form's fill-in line ("Manufacturer: ......") and a clause right after a section's own contents list are read - they were left out
Documents: a catalogue with a different product photo in the same frame on every page - the photos are compared, not taken for a logo
Big PDFs in BOQ and Documents are read as needed: four 400 MB files open at once take about 180 MB of memory, not 2.2 GB; checking a 400 MB drawing file takes about 100 MB, not 1 GB
Drawings: very heavy sheets (millions of lines) are merged in a stream - peak memory 2.3 GB → 0.85 GB
Reading the text of a PDF is faster (a 3,000-page specification: 20 s → 12 s a side); after scanned pages are read by OCR, the other pages are not read a second time
A broken or odd file (a stray character in a drawing, a file that is not a PDF in the folder) no longer stalls an engine or fills the memory

New features: Documents: side by side - the old and new issues' own pages, each paragraph changed marked and the words taken out / put in boxed on the page; click a change on either side and the other side goes to it; scroll and the other side follows (a Word file shows its paragraphs as rows)
Documents: the same legend and "Minor changes" switch as the BOQ - moved, number only (renumbered) and punctuation only are drawn light and can be hidden
Fixes: BOQ: "Heading reworded" is a normal change again, not a minor one - the heading says what the item is (3mm aluminium sheet or 1 inch steel plate)
Drawings: "+6 more" under a change's texts opens the rest of them ("Show fewer" closes them)
Documents: one spec against one is paired whatever the file names (a date such as "_06042026" was read as a section number - a spec reissued from DD to TD showed as one section removed and one added)
Documents: "C.4"-style clause numbers are numbers - a renumbered appendix clause is no longer a change of its text
Side by side: pages fit the pane by the usual page width (a few A3 pages scroll sideways instead of shrinking every page)

New features: BOQ side by side: a legend says what each colour means; minor changes (moved, letter only, heading above reworded - the item's own line the same) are drawn light and can be hidden with "Minor changes"
BOQ: a reworded heading is boxed on the page itself and its changed words are shown under the two sides
Fixes: BOQ PDFs laid out as "ITEM / NO." over "ITEM DESCRIPTION": descriptions were read into the item column - doors, gym equipment and "3mm" / "2 layer" items showed false changes
BOQ PDFs: "(CONT'D.)" headings, page references ("Sec J/Page 10/R4") and bill summary pages no longer read as changes or items; a bill's title under the header starts its bill
BOQ: a sub-heading after a page break ("Common Area") is no longer read under a heading of that name from another section
BOQ side by side: scrolling keeps the two sides level across page breaks (page headers and footers count less), and to the ends of both issues
BOQ: "Check" marks only doubtful pairings and items read from scans - not every item of a PDF

New features: BOQ: side by side shows a PDF BOQ as its own pages, the changes marked on them (the changed cells boxed) - click a change on either side and the other side goes to it, even in another file; scroll and the other side follows
BOQ: "Table as read" shows the PDF's table as it was read (what was compared); zoom on PDF pages (- / +, Ctrl + wheel)
BOQ: scrolling follows the bill in view - a PDF of every bill against a workbook of a sheet per bill keeps to the same bill; picking a sheet's tab takes the PDF to that bill's pages

BOQ: side by side - the old and new sheets as laid out, the changes coloured in them; click a change on either side and the other side goes to it, even in another sheet; scroll and the other side follows on the matching sheet
BOQ: a tab per sheet with its count of changes, a change map beside each scrollbar, and the change in short (word by word) under the sheets
BOQ: Details keeps the field-by-field view; "New issue is changed pages only" is on the bar in side by side
Scanned PDFs (no text layer) are now read by OCR in the BOQ and Documents tabs; what comes from a scan is marked "check"
Your ticks on BOQ and Documents changes are kept: compare the same files again and they are still ticked (a file issued again drops them)
Fixed: BOQ: bills in a set are matched bill by bill ("_Bill-2" was not read as Bill 2 - Tower 1's items could be paired with Tower 2's)
BOQ: a bill renumbered in the new issue ("Bill-01" for "Bill-2") is matched by what is in it
BOQ: look-alike items keep their own Ref / Type (fan coil units, doors) instead of being swapped
BOQ: a short description ("Upstand walls") is no longer paired across a unit change with another tower's item
BOQ: the bill's title repeated at the top of each page is no longer read as a section; "(Cont'd)" headings no longer add text
BOQ from PDF: much better reading - a sheet per bill, covers and summaries left out, wrapped descriptions and centred quantities read with their item
Documents: a word broken at its hyphen in a PDF keeps the hyphen
A file with no BOQ table (a sign schedule) now says so instead of "nothing changed"
BOQ: "Sr. No. | Item No. | Description" sheets read the item number, not the serial number
BOQ from PDF: a column heading over two lines ("AMOUNT" / "AED"), "Unit Rate" headings and "PTC 2" footers read right; page numbers are the PDF's own

New features: BOQ tab: compare two issues of a bill of quantities (Excel or PDF, or folders of bills) - every item paired wherever it went
BOQ: quantities, units, descriptions, rates changed, items added, removed or moved; renumbering and rounding shown apart
BOQ: "New issue is changed pages only" for addenda that re-issue only the pages that changed
Documents tab: compare two issues of specifications or other documents (PDF or Word, books or folders of sections)
Documents: spec sections paired by number, paragraphs by text - headers, footers, page numbers and dates left out
Both tabs: the same review as the drawings (N, P, R), and an Excel change register

Fixed: Opening the next sheet quickly could show the sheet before under the new sheet's change boxes
After "Again" on a sheet issued again under the same name, zooming in showed the old drawing (or nothing)
After "Again", a sheet with more changes could stay ticked off, and N could skip its new changes
"Try again" on a sheet that could not be read left it blank; a sheet that can't be opened now says so, with Try again
The Fade slider works over its whole range, and the whole sheet has the same greys as the zoomed-in view
Highlight tints only the paper: unchanged lines keep their grey
Sheet titles in Arabic and other scripts are kept (list, search, Excel, PDF)
Monster sheets: a lost or failed merge is redone instead of being remembered as nothing to merge
Updates: a double click on Update, or changing the updates folder during a check, no longer fails the update; after Go back, an accepted update starts as promised
Clouded PDF: a stretched part has an orange dashed outline, as in the viewer, not a red cloud
Smaller fixes: same-named files on both sides are told apart in the header; folders deeper than 12 levels are read; setup keeps your own file if the new version brings one with the same name

New features: Highlight (toolbar button or H): a faint yellow fill in the change boxes, and a yellow dot on changes too small to see - easier on a poor screen or weaker eyes. Lines keep their colour
Faster: The next sheet is made ready while you look at the current one: going on with N or R, it opens sharp, zoomed on its first change
Blended CAD sheets: the next change shows in about 1-3 s instead of up to 13 s on sheets reached with N or R; panning no longer redraws
Zooming quickly with the wheel draws only the last zoom, not every step in between
Comparing in the background no longer slows down the sheet on screen
Moving the Fade slider no longer redraws whole sheets
Sheets with a moved view draw about twice as fast

New features: A plan moved a few mm on the sheet (up to 20 mm) is lined up on its own: listed as "Moved 1.9 mm down" with a dashed outline (also in the clouded PDF), and only its real changes are listed; a sheet where nothing else changed says "Moved only" (level plans moved a little on the sheet)
Part of a drawing that moved because the drawing was stretched (a floor made taller, a bay made wider) is listed as "Stretched 3.0 mm up", with the seam marked - the sheet stays Changed
Sheets pair by name with a leading zero, a project prefix or an issue date added or dropped ("100101" / "F111.1-...-100101", "GA-L04" / "F111.1-AE7-DWG-AR-GA-L04")
Fixes: Sheet numbers are shown as written ("F111.1-AE7-..."), without the revision code or the file name repeated as the title
A level code like "R1" is not taken for a revision ("...-R1" and "...-R2" are two sheets); "unpair" is remembered after a pair made by hand
Old / New / Side by side show the sheets as issued, with the boxes where the drawing is
A sheet whose old issue is a scan no longer lists every word as added
A quarter-turned sheet no longer says it was moved 594 mm
Blended CAD sheets: a cause of the engine stopping at random removed
Remembered comparisons, ticks and hand-made pairs can no longer be wiped when another program holds the settings file for a moment
Save errors say what happened (file open in Excel, folder gone, disk full)
Sheets that never finished (CAD sheets drawn with a page-wide blend mode, e.g. some tower floor plans) are compared in under a minute and shown in the viewer
A sheet that could not be compared opens side by side
The progress line says when sheets take long instead of "about a minute left"

New features: Setup: installs for everyone on the PC (or just you), Start menu shortcut, uninstall from Windows
Updates itself from the company updates folder - asks first, no helper program for the antivirus to block
Go back to the previous version from Settings
General polishing: Overview of all sheets first; Start review / Enter; N ticks a sheet off once all its changes were seen
Tiny changes come last on a sheet, after one stop that says so
Removed and unreadable sheets are part of the review
Mini-map when zoomed in; your zoom is kept from change to change
Excel: title block changes, where each change is, why a sheet could not be compared
Fixes: A sheet re-issued under the same file name loses its tick (and says so)
A stopped comparison no longer reads as all reviewed
Fast typing in the sheet search lost letters
PDF summary page columns overlapped
